attributes.name: Isabella "Inkskin" Locke
attributes.powers:
All damage from Isabella "Inkskin" Locke is Acid damage.

Before you act, recharge a card, then summon and encounter the ship Thresher.

After you act, Isabella deals you 1 Acid damage.

"See this tattoo here? I had it done after I gutted the last pirate who tried to get his hands on my map."—Isabella Locke
